text: 金十数据11月10日讯，2026年11月6日，美国WobbleWorks Inc.根据《美国1930年关税法》第337节规定向美国国际贸易委员会提出申请，指控对美出口、在美进口及销售的特定手持三维绘图设备（Certain Handheld Three-Dimensional Drawing Devices）侵犯其专利权，请求发起337调查，并发布有限排除令和禁止令。中国、美国、新加坡共3家企业涉案。
text_en: Jinshi Data, November 10: On November 6, 2026, WobbleWorks Inc. of the United States filed an application with the U.S. International Trade Commission under Section 337 of the U.S. Tariff Act of 1930, alleging that certain handheld three-dimensional drawing devices exported to, imported into, and sold in the United States infringe its patent rights, and requesting the initiation of a Section 337 investigation and the issuance of a limited exclusion order and a cease and desist order. A total of three companies from China, the United States, and Singapore are involved.
